request: Add subtle coordinated torso/body and hair/coat follow-through, plus an obvious black-red sword-swing effect.
scope: Keep approved extended-elbow/shoulder-led slash, add small body participation and a dark crimson upward swing trail.

stages.intent: Body follow-through and initial swing effect.
stages.prompt:
EDIT the attached approved 4x4 sprite sheet. It is the edit target, not a loose style reference. Return 16 COMPLETE full-body cels in the same row-major frame order 0..15 and the same 4x4 grid. Add ONLY subtle whole-body participation and a restrained sword-swing trail. Preserve the accepted upward draw-slash motion and character: long white hair, red eyes, charcoal/red-piped uniform, ivory cape/coat, brown gloves/boots/belt, straight silver katana, black sheath/red tassel. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds sword, LEFT holds sheath throughout. Very important: in f6..11 the sword arm remains nearly straight with the same relaxed elbow extension and wrist-to-grip-to-blade alignment as the input. The extended arm and sword rise slightly together at the shoulder and come back, not bending the elbow inward, not spinning the wrist. Keep the same sword length and approved angles/trajectory. Retain connected shoulders and elbows, natural human proportions, opaque continuous sleeves, no seams or joint plugs.
BODY MOTION: make the motion involve the chest/waist, rather than leaving a frozen torso while the arm moves. Feet/boot soles stay planted at the same two ground contacts in every cell; same scale, no stepping or floating. Use a small torso twist and lean around the pelvis, not rigid rotation of the entire character. f0/1 ready pose unchanged. f2..4 slight anticipation: chest/shoulders draw back about2 degrees, knees soften slightly. f5..8 swing: pelvis shifts only a little, chest/shoulders rotate about4-5 degrees and lean subtly into the sword's upward-left action, upper torso moves only a few pixels relative to planted feet. The sword shoulder follows the torso naturally while the approved arm configuration remains intact. f9 settle at the restrained shoulder follow-through peak. f10..13 body eases back; head/long hair and coat hems follow the chest with about1-2 frames of delay, using small natural counter-motion, not violently flaring. f14/15 settle into the same ready stance as f0. Clear but small changes in chest angle, shoulder line, head balance, hair tips and coat hem across the sequence. Do not squash/stretch body or limbs, do not change face or anatomy. One character per cell.
SWORD FX: a clean, slim translucent silver-white crescent speed trail showing where the blade has just swept from LOWER LEFT to UPPER LEFT. It is a short tapered ribbon/afterglint at the OUTER BLADE and behind the blade tip, strongest in f6/7/8, with a very faint first streak in f5 and rapidly fading remnants in f9/10; no trail in f0..4 or f11..15. Follow the real blade-tip path from the preceding lower pose up to the current blade, giving a short arc, roughly30-50 degrees, not a full circle. Trail stays behind the blade in motion, never a beam fired out ahead. Sharp thin bright leading rim and a translucent tapered trailing tail, minimal bloom. Keep it compact inside its own cell; do not crop any blade/trail or bleed into neighboring cels. On the returning f10 do not draw a fresh reversed slash: only the earlier upward trail fading away. No fire, no explosion, no magical projectile, no huge aura, no body afterimages, no duplicate sword or extra hand. FX must NOT cover the face, hair mass, shoulder, elbow, forearm, glove or sheath; the joint anatomy must remain clearly readable. Avoid background glow. Preserve existing rendering style, palette, crisp outlines and all costume detail. Transparent background with alpha ZERO between sprites, no gray haze, no floor shadow, no text or annotations.
VIEW: front-facing character. Sword arm stays on screen-left, sheath hand on screen-right. Chest twist stays small enough to remain front-facing; counterbalance head only slightly. Do not turn into a side pose.

stages.intent: Preserve body motion; replace draft effect with strong black-red trail following upward sweep.
stages.prompt:
EDIT the attached 4x4 full-body attack sprite sheet. The image is the exact edit target. Keep all 16 poses, body movement, costume, face, arm anatomy, planted boots, cell positions and the approved sword motion exactly as drawn. Preserve subtle torso follow-through, hair/coat counter-motion and especially the almost-straight sword arm in frames6..11, unchanged wrist grip. Anatomical RIGHT hand sword, LEFT hand sheath. Do not redraw the attack as a different action.
CHANGE ONLY THE SWORD-SWING FX, as requested: make it clearly visible DEEP BLACK-RED / DARK CRIMSON. Replace EVERY silver-white effect completely. Create a bold, clean tapered crescent ribbon with a dark black-maroon inner body (wine/oxblood), a saturated crimson-red visible face, and a thin vivid scarlet cutting rim. It should read strongly even at small game-sprite size, not a faint gray whisper. Rich dark red, not pink, orange, white, blue, or fire. The sword itself stays straight silver metal; only the swept trail is red-black. No blood splatter, no droplets, no injury, no explosion, no projectile or beam.
Correct the trail direction and containment: this slash goes LOW TO HIGH. In frames5..8 the dark-red trailing tail curves DOWNWARD toward the immediately PREVIOUS LOWER sword pose; the sharp bright leading rim meets the outer third of the CURRENT blade. It must not hook above the blade as if this were a downward strike. The trail follows the outward blade-tip arc from below-left/upward, not the face or elbow. Frame5 is a small emerging dark-red streak, frames6/7/8 carry the strong readable red-black crescent, frame9 fades to a slimmer trail, frame10 only one small dim fading remnant. No new reverse slash on recovery. No FX at all in frames0..4 or11..15. Keep every effect entirely WITHIN ITS OWN CELL with clear empty space around it; do not cross grid edges or neighboring sprites. If a blade tip is near the left cell border, attach the effect a little behind that tip on the outer blade and curve the entire tail downward and inward (screen-right), never extend left beyond that tip. All FX pixels need a small empty margin from cell borders. Trail compact, at most about one-third of body height, still bold and visible. Never cover any face, shoulder, elbow, wrist, hand, torso or sheath. No full-circle aura or body ghosts. Preserve current body art and all existing blade positions. Keep whole complete cels, no detached patches.
Return the same 4x4 transparent PNG sheet. Outside the character and the red effect silhouette, background must be fully transparent alpha ZERO: remove incidental gray speckles/clouds, no ground shadows or colored background wash. Preserve real antialiased hair and effect edges, no surrounding glow haze. No words, labels or annotations.
Maintain FRONT view and same character size. Ensure especially frame8 (third row, first column) has NO effect cut by the sheet's left edge. The prior effects of f6 (row2 col3) and f7 (row2 col4) cross into the previous cell. FIX this explicitly: all red trails stay inside their cell, at least12 pixels from its left boundary, attach to the outer blade behind the tip when necessary. Same12px minimum on f8 at the image left edge. Do not move any character or sword to solve this.
